data.one_liner: Flutter widgets to view and download email messages using enough_mail.
data.what_it_does: Provides MimeMessageViewer to render already‑fetched MIME messages and MimeMessageDownloader to fetch content on demand. It integrates with enough_mail and uses InAppWebView for rich HTML rendering, supporting dark mode and external image blocking.
use_when: You need to display email content in a Flutter app
You already use the enough_mail library for mail handling
You want built‑in support for HTML rendering, dark mode, and image handling
avoid_when: You are not building an email client
You require a pure web solution without native webview
You need a custom rendering engine not based on InAppWebView
strengths: Supports dark mode and external image blocking
Allows custom fetch methods and download timeouts
Uses InAppWebView for accurate HTML rendering
weaknesses: Depends on native InAppWebView, adding platform setup
data.setup_notes: Add dependency overrides for xml (^6.0.1) and ensure InAppWebView platform setup (Android/iOS) as per its docs
